_comment: PROVEN ICF (identical-COMDAT-folding) symbol aliases for objdiff.
Retail RB3's /O1 build folds the debug-stripped 2-arg POOL_OVERLOAD
operator-new path into the named 5-arg debug allocator: both spellings
live at ONE address in the XEX, so only the 5-arg mangled name appears in
scripts/target_symbol_map.json. Our compiled objs emit the byte-IDENTICAL
call site (li r3,N / li r4,N / bl) but reference the 2-arg name, so objdiff
(which compares bl relocations BY NAME via objdiff-core reloc_eq) flags a
[sym] mismatch even though the machine code matches exactly.
This file declares the PROVEN folds. tools/gen_symbol_alias_map.py turns it
into an MSVC-linker-map-format file (build/45410914/icf_aliases.map) that
objdiff's existing symbol_equivalences mechanism (objdiff-core map_file.rs,
wired via objdiff.json 'map_file') consumes: symbols that share an address
in the map are treated as reloc-name-equal. NO objdiff source change needed.
GATE: each group is seeded ONLY by byte-identical-call-site evidence
(a paired 'bl <5arg>' / 'bl <2arg>' diff row where the relocation type and
addend match and the surrounding bytes are equal), NEVER by fuzzy matching.
Each group must contain EXACTLY ONE symbol that exists at a real address in
scripts/target_symbol_map.json (the survivor the ICF fold kept); the others
are the spellings our compiled code emits that the fold absorbed.
Each group's 'address' is the survivor's address in target_symbol_map.json
(used as the synthetic map address so parse_msvc_map groups them); it is NOT
load-bearing beyond being a unique per-group key.
VALIDATION: tools/icf_alias_finder.py --validate confirms (a) exactly one
survivor per group is in target_symbol_map.json, (b) every other spelling is
referenced by at least one of our compiled objs, and (c) at least one
function exhibits the paired-bl byte-identical-call-site signature.
==== LANE CD-9 (2026-07-31): REGENERATED FROM EVIDENCE, NOT INHERITED ====
This file is GENERATED, but it is a FIXED POINT and not a derived artifact:
re-running the recipe does NOT reproduce it, and running it to 'refresh' the
file is a regression. See the 2026-08-20 block below for the measured price.
Regenerate (in a built worktree), writing every input somewhere DURABLE:
D=<decomp-bench>/archive/runs/<date>-<lane>/inputs
python3 tools/icf_site_census.py   --out $D/sites.json
python3 tools/icf_fold_evidence.py --out $D/evidence.json
python3 tools/icf_alias_build.py --enumerate census \
--sites $D/sites.json --evidence $D/evidence.json \
--merge scripts/symbol_aliases.json --out $D/../out/candidate.json
Then DIFF the candidate against this file and price the map channel before
adopting anything; `ninja` rebuilds build/45410914/icf_aliases.map (gitignored)
and report.json. Audit with tools/icf_alias_audit.py, tools/icf_decoy_control.py.
==== 2026-08-20: WHAT A REGENERATION COSTS, AND WHY THE INPUTS MOVED ====
The recipe above used to write its census and evidence into ~/tmp, which is not
storage -- the 2026-07-31 inputs survived twenty days by luck. They are archived
with their uncompressed sha256 at
<decomp-bench>/archive/runs/2026-08-20-alias-inputs-durable/inputs-2026-07-31/
and they are PROVENANCE, not a starting point: the tree has grown 1,095 -> 1,205
objs since, so regenerating from them re-derives less than half of what a fresh
census does. Re-run both tools first.
Priced control-first against the shipped file (matched_code 3,758,880), same
objects, map channel only, report-only A/B:
The loss is validator-gate drops on landed groups -- dominated by gate (b),
'folded spelling referenced by 0 compiled objs', then gate (a), 'survivor no
longer in target_symbol_map.json'. Hand adjudication has moved this file far
past what the generator can re-derive, and no re-derivation carries that back.
Note also that the generator unions on the SURVIVOR NAME alone, so a star of
separately adjudicated pairs ships as a clique. That defect is diagnosed at its
emission site in tools/icf_alias_build.py and DELIBERATELY unfixed: the only
available predicate asks the fold question of our build, and /OPT:ICF folded in
retail's link (revert 760cb450; tools/test_icf_alias_no_ourbuild_gate.py).
Lane CB-11/A's 465-group file was NOT reproducible: its builder read an
uncommitted CB-9 pickle, and 4 of its groups came from an uncommitted merge.
CD-9 replaced the pickle with tools/icf_site_census.py (committed), carries the
hand-verified groups via --merge, and tightened the retail-placeholder tolerance
(a retail 'fn_<B>' callee is a REFUTATION, not a tolerance, when our callee is
map-resident -- the dtk renamer only leaves fn_<B> when B is absent from the map).
Cross-validated against an independent retail-vs-ours body-hash enumerator:
the two derivations agree EXACTLY on all 394 retail-adjudicated (T1) pairs.
Negative decoy control: the relocation gate kills 96.8% of the pairs a naive
masked-byte comparator would accept (554,705 of 573,290).

FOLD-THUNK TIER (FT, lane H, 2026-08-12) -- the groups whose evidence string names tools/fold_thunk_gate.py depart from the 'exactly ONE map-resident symbol per group' gate above, DELIBERATELY. In this class BOTH spellings are map-resident, which is the whole reason the earlier residency triage misread them as wrong callees: target_symbol_map.json is a VA->name FUNCTION over an ICF-folded link, so it parks the loser of a fold on whatever address is left -- padding, a mid-function word, an unrelated thunk, or ANOTHER MODULE'S FUNCTION OF THE SAME NAME. Each FT group therefore carries, per folded spelling, either proof that the map's other address holds the same body or a measured reason it is not retail's copy of our symbol. Do NOT re-add a score-based discredit: a low `none` score says two bodies differ, never which of them is misnamed. See docs/plans/fold-thunk-alias-gate-2026-08-12.md.

CF4 TIER REMOVED (lane CF4-FIX, 2026-08-13) -- tools/comdat_fold_gate.py's CF4 admitted a pair merely because target_symbol_map.json listed addr(F) in _bijection_arbitrary/_icf_arbitrary. That warrant was a property of the functionRelocDiffs=none ruler; under name_check an alias is PURE FORGIVENESS, so an unproven one lifts the score BY CONSTRUCTION with no byte evidence. All 3 CF4 groups ever installed were adjudicated on retail bytes and all 3 were REFUTED -- each was a pair of adjacent addresses whose NAMES ARE SWAPPED (ObjDirItr<RndPollable|RndAnimatable> ctor and operator++; SongDB::GetGemList / GetGemListByDiff), proven map-independently via the ??_R0 RTTI type-descriptor strings the ObjDirItr<T>::Advance bodies load. Gate (a) proves an IDENTIFICATION, not a fold: our COMDAT matching retail's body at addr(S) means addr(S) IS F and the MAP ROW IS WRONG. The remedy is a map row repair, which the alias foreclosed. See tools/comdat_fold_gate.py 'REMOVED TIER CF4'.

(2) The two RETAIL bodies are the same size with 128 B both sides, 0 of 32 words differ; the recursive callee ??$__unguarded_linear_insert@...Cmp@@ also differs per comparator, but their RELOCATION TARGETS differ. MSVC /OPT:ICF folds only COMDATs identical INCLUDING RELOCATIONS, so shape identity with differing relocations is precisely the population that does NOT fold -- the documented _List_base<T>::clear case (42 addresses, reloc-identical surplus 0, because members differ in per-T callee targets). (3) tools/alias_forgiveness_audit.Sides.verdict() returns CONTRADICTED: target names differ @0x2c: ??RAccomplishmentCmp@@QBA_NVSymbol@@0@Z vs ??RGoalCmp@@QBA_NVSymbol@@0@Z. Repaired, not refused: the group is partitioned into the 40 classes the evidence does support. `disposition: repartitioned` = re-emitted as its own class in a group immediately following; `dropped_singleton` = its class has one member, and one member is not a fold.

groups.withdrawn_reason: lane W41-CONTRA (2026-08-17): NOT A FOLD -- adjudicated on retail bytes, all five standing CONTRADICTED groups. These groups asserted a fold between _Rb_tree instantiations whose parent bodies ARE byte-identical modulo relocations -- but every differing relocation names the member's OWN instantiation sibling (_M_create_node / _M_insert / insert_unique), so the claim is a FIXPOINT that holds only if the callee chain folds. It does not: _M_create_node differs per value_type (node size / value-copy). Measured our-side (84/92/100/108/112 B, and DIFFERING BYTES AT EQUAL SIZE for <int,float> vs <int,bool> vs <int,int>, so the verdict does NOT rest on a size comparison) and corroborated retail-side: where the root is named in the target objs, retail's size equals ours per instantiation, so retail's roots differ from each other too. W39-PUSHBACK's dtk-`bctr`-truncation artifact was checked and is ABSENT here: 0 of 17 carves end in an unconditional bctr and retail_len == ours_len on every row. MAP IS RIGHT, ALIAS WAS WRONG: 11 of 12 diagonals (retail body at the mapped address vs our compiled body for that same spelling) are IDENTICAL, so each map name is corroborated at its own address. PRICE: removing all 16 memberships measured EXACTLY 0 on every key (Δmatched=0, Δcode_bytes=0, `none` flat, 0 units fell off) -- all 16 are live symbols in our objs but none sat on a CHARGED site, i.e. this was forgiveness surface buying 0 B. Do NOT re-add without first proving the _M_create_node root folds. RESIDUAL FOR A FUTURE LANE: the 11 withdrawn members are not mutually unfoldable -- they form sub-clusters by root body: {<int,bool>, <TrackType,bool>} (root sha 0b0f92e41f), {<int,int>, <int,AnimState>, <int,RevealState>, <TrackType,int>} (root ae01dfb415), and {<TrackType,PlayerStreakData@PerfectOverdrive>, <TrackType,PlayerStreakData@PerfectSection>} (root 17a36a67f1). None shares the survivor <int,float> (root b7abd8b746), which is why ALL 11 left THIS group. Note also that this group's address (0x8233c668) is where the map places <int,bool>, NOT the survivor <int,float> (0x82271f58) -- the group was a conflation of several distinct fold clusters. A correctly-homed group would need its own survivor and its own evidence.

restored.verdict: FOLD -- PROVEN on retail bytes by three independent instruments
restored.why_the_original_premise_failed: The premise was a UNITS error, and both of its successors inherited it. GROUNDED-1 compared retail's `.pdata` FUNCTION extent (96/100 B) against a COMDAT SPAN read out of our object (104/108 B) and read the 8-byte difference as a body-size difference. It is the FUNCLET PREFIX. Retail's own symbols.txt names an 8-byte `except_data` object at A+extent and the `__unwind$`/`__catch$` funclet as its own function at A+extent+8, at every one of the six -- so 96 and 104 are two different spans of ONE layout, not two body sizes, and 'two COMDATs of different size cannot fold' never applied. ALIAS-2 2026-08-16 corrected the const/non-const half of the diagnosis (our two spellings are the SAME size within our build) but kept the withdrawal pending positive fold evidence, and attributed the residual +8 to a shared STLport source defect; STLPORT-1 (rb3-xenon `ff832b50`) then showed that +8 was `tools/coff_bodies_ext.py` billing the successor's EH prefix to the preceding function. This lane supplies the positive evidence the ALIAS-2 note asked for.
restored.evidence: Three instruments with no shared failure mode, all seven memberships (the six + the never-withdrawn control 0x827148b0), uniform: (A) objdiff-cli 4.2.3 at the instruction level, on the retail-split target object and on a scratch copy of it renamed to the FOLDED spelling -- target_size == base_size (96/96 or 100/100) and EVERY instruction equal, diff score 0, at the shipped `functionRelocDiffs=none`; (B) a direct raw-byte compare against orig/45410914/band.exe over the full COMDAT span (144/148/152 B = function + 8 B funclet prefix + funclet), full 32-bit words, skipping only words our object relocates -- 0 mismatches for BOTH spellings, and our(survivor) raw == our(folded) raw exactly; (C) probe_icf_foldtest.py --explain -- FOLD, 7 of 7. The residual `name_check` differences are relocation TARGET NAMES only (`_Copy_Construct` vs `_Param_Construct`, `MemOrPoolAlloc` vs `MemOrPoolAllocSTL`, and the inner `__uninitialized_copy` PA/PB spelling) -- each a separate fold one level down, and the never-withdrawn CONTROL carries the same one. Run of record: <decomp-bench>/archive/runs/2026-08-16-grounded2-restoration/; lane report: decomp-synth docs/plans/il-witness/GROUNDED2_RESTORATION_2026-08-16.md.

superseded_record.why: different body SIZE (96 vs 104) -- cannot be one COMDAT
superseded_record.note: CORRECTED by ALIAS-2 2026-08-16. The original reason -- 'different body SIZE (different body SIZE (96 vs 104) -- cannot be one COMDAT) -- cannot be one COMDAT ... we instantiate a different overload' -- compared RETAIL's survivor against OUR folded spelling, which are two different builds. Measured WITHIN our build, our(survivor) == our(folded) == same B, so the two spellings are NOT different-sized COMDATs and that argument does not refute the fold. The real divergence is that our STLport emits the whole __uninitialized_copy / _M_allocate_and_copy family UNIFORMLY +8 B vs retail (52 of 57 and 43 of 47 size-differing same-name pairs). ⇒ This is ONE shared source defect in the STLport copy helpers, NOT a per-pair wrong overload. The membership stays WITHDRAWN because refuting a refutation yields UNPROVEN, not PROVEN; do not re-add it without positive fold evidence.

STL MEMBERSHIP ADJUDICATED ON RETAIL BYTES, lane STLALLOC-1 2026-08-14 (this was the largest row of the 'UNPROVABLE -- needs absent source' class, 28,624 B of 44,140). The open question was whether retail's 1-arg STL form carries a temp guard (dc3 spells `{MemTemp tmp; MemAlloc(...);}`) or a different threshold (rb3-Wii spells STL 0x100 vs plain 0x80) -- either of which makes it a DIFFERENT body that cannot fold. Both oracle forms are REFUTED for RB3-360. (a) NO GUARD: 0x827bd208 is a frameless 36-byte leaf that TAIL-BRANCHES (`b`, not `bl`) to both callees; a guard's dtor makes a tail branch impossible. (b) NO 0x100 THRESHOLD: a whole-.text scan finds ZERO 0x100-vs-r3 compares near any allocator branch, while the identical probe run at 0x80 finds the dispatcher at 0x827bd214 -- so the instrument discriminates and returns NO. Retail has exactly ONE pool/heap alloc dispatcher image-wide. groups.name: _M_create_node
groups.evidence: CORRECTED by lane W6-ACCURACY on retail bytes. The group previously named the map<int,float> spelling as SURVIVOR and set<MoveDetector*> as folded -- the roles were INVERTED, because target_symbol_map.json/0x8235c328 carried the wrong name. Retail's body at 0x8235c328 allocates 0x14 (li r3,0x14) and copies ONE word (lwz/stw) into node+0x10, i.e. a 4-byte value_type. pair<const int,float> is 8 bytes and needs 0x18 + two copies, so a map<int,float> node builder CANNOT be this body. set<MoveDetector*> (value_type = a 4-byte pointer) fits exactly, and our compiled body is byte-identical to retail's 76 bytes once the single relocation slot at +0x18 is masked (both call MemOrPoolAlloc/STL, already equated by group @0x827bd208). Corroborated independently: retail _M_insert@set<MoveDetector*> at 0x8235C538 -- already pinned to MoveAsyncDetector.cpp -- calls 0x8235C328 three times. | Lane W7-D, T1 on retail bytes (2026-09-13). Our COMDAT for the folded spelling and our COMDAT for the survivor are both 76 B, sha256 56915aab763000b5, with IDENTICAL relocations compared BY TARGET NAME: (24,?MemOrPoolAllocSTL@@YAPAXH@Z). Retail@0x8235c328 corroborates (same size; every non-relocated word equal as a full 32-bit value). Every relocation target is TYPE-INDEPENDENT, which is why this family folds where list<T*>::insert / vector<T>::resize / ~list<T> do NOT (those carry a per-T callee -- _M_create_node<T>, _M_fill_insert<T>, _List_base<T>::clear -- and retail keeps 4, 48 and 11 of them respectively at DISTINCT addresses). Injective: the map places the folded spelling at no other address. Population control: no other retail address carries a branch-masked-identical body.

Second, independent witness that this was never a fold: symbol_equivalences gate (c') ALREADY drops this member -- the target map gives OggFree its own address 0x8249b200 against the survivor's -- so the membership was never in the admission predicate.

restored.why: The withdrawal is KEPT (its record is still the ledger's, and the denylist still keys on it); this membership is re-admitted deliberately via scripts/alias_withdrawal_overrides.json, because the withdrawal's PREMISE no longer holds. That premise was a statement about OUR build, not retail: 'our(S)=96 B vs our(F)=88 B [retail(S)=96]'. Retail was always 96. Our 88-byte body was a SOURCE defect, now fixed: Transform::operator= and Hmx::Matrix3::operator= are both user-declared, which made ExtraTail's implicit copy-assign MEMBERWISE (a 0x40 memcpy plus two scalar stores) instead of one whole-object memcpy. That fatter loop body is what stopped MSVC inlining STLport's __copy into vector<ExtraTail>::_M_erase. Giving ExtraTail an explicit memcpy operator= (src/band3/game/TrainerGemTab.h) restores the inlined form.
restored.evidence: tools/icf_pair_adjudicate.py --survivor <this group's survivor> --ours <spelling>: FLAT T1 PROVEN. retail_size 96, our_size 96, reloc_tally {} over n_relocs 3, survivor_map_resident True. The same run's --selftest passes WITH a REFUTED negative control, so the instrument is shown able to fail. Corroborated by two sibling STL functions on these same two element types already folding in this file: __uninitialized_copy (survivor ExtraTail, Point folded) and __uninitialized_fill_n. The element types are the same size -- both 72 B (0x48), compiler-verified -- and retail's own erase body loads `li r10, 0x48` as its stride.
restored.note: The withdrawal record's 'Do NOT re-add' was correct while our body was 88 B: different-sized COMDATs cannot fold. It is superseded by a source change, not overruled by judgment. groups.name: resize

Per CLAUDE.md (CD-7) MSVC folds only COMDATs identical INCLUDING relocations, so the direct-fold claim as filed is refuted -- this is the same shape as _List_base<T>::clear, which has 42 addresses and reloc-identical surplus 0. The fold is nonetheless REAL and TRANSITIVE: /OPT:ICF iterates to a fixed point, the referenced erase and insert families fold first, and the two resize bodies then become reloc-identical and fold. PROVEN ON RETAIL BYTES, not on map absence: (a) each of our two COMDATs is masked-equal to the SAME retail body word-for-word (36 words, 0 unexplained differing words, opcode/AA/LK preserved by the mask, only relocated fields skipped); (b) DECISIVELY, every relocated branch destination resolves to the SAME retail ADDRESS for both spellings (off 88 -> 0x824e0e40, off 124 -> 0x824e0f00), so after folding the two bodies are identical in bytes AND in destinations; (c) retail keeps exactly ONE body per family and names it with an arbitrary member spelling (erase survives as Transform, insert survives as Instance, resize survives as Transform) -- the arbitrary-survivor-spelling signature. Map absence of the rival spellings was NOT used as evidence (CLAUDE.md: absence measures identification coverage, ~1.95x, not folding). Control: 0x8241b618 ?resize@list<Instance,TransformListAlloc<Instance>> is the REAL RndMultiMesh::InstanceList instantiation (MultiMesh.h typedef), a different COMDAT that did NOT fold and sits at its own address at fuzzy 100 -- so the method distinguishes folding from mere same-name similarity. So the incumbent was a SURVIVOR_SIZE_MISMATCH of exactly the class W16-AZ withdrew twice, and an alias group built on it would have been a FABRICATED membership that lifts name_check by construction. WHAT THE ADDRESS ACTUALLY IS: a 24 B-element instantiation.
